summary: Green Circle Decarbonize Technology Ltd, a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer listed on the NYSE under GCDT, furnished a Form 6-K on October 6, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a planned expansion into the AI data center cooling market using proprietary phase-change material and liquid cooling technology. The release states the company is in preliminary technical discussions and evaluations with industry participants and data center operators, with no agreements, partners, capital commitments, or financial terms disclosed. No securities transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is implicated. Watch for follow-on disclosure on commercialization, partnerships, and funding needs.
